name: The Loft on Folsom
tagline: A SoMa loft for 30 to 150, built for a product demo and a reception: screen, mics, livestream, strong Wi-Fi.
bio: I'm Theo. I run a converted print shop in SoMa for developer meetups, launch nights and demo-and-drinks evenings. I staff the AV myself and work with two caterers, so your quote has everything in it.
terms: Free to cancel up to 21 days before. Inside 21 days, 50%.
backupPlan: Two AV techs on my team; one is always on site.

experiences.name: Demo night and reception
experiences.desc: A 20-minute demo with your slides on the big screen, then food and drinks for everyone. Livestream optional.
includes: Screen, two mics, livestream to YouTube or Zoom
Heavy appetizers and two drink tickets
experiences.allIn: Venue, AV tech, food, two drinks a person, staff, cleanup and tax.
experiences.av: 16-ft screen, 2 wireless mics, livestream rig, 1 Gbps Wi-Fi
experiences.dietary: Caterer covers vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free.
experiences.access: Freight elevator and ramp; step-free throughout.
experiences.setup: Load-in from 4pm; branding hung by our team.
experiences.branding: Banner, screen loops and branded cups. Needs 1 week.

experiences.name: Breakfast roundtable room
experiences.desc: The mezzanine for 8 to 16 people: quiet, one table, a screen if you need it.
